errors.text_span: най-късите стълбове се наблюдават през 2001 г. и 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The description identifies the bars for 2001 and 2019 as the shortest. While the bar for 2001 is indeed one of the shortest, the bar for 2019 is visibly taller than the bars for 2016 and 2020, making the statement inaccurate.
